providerEvidence.quote: 实际费用以请求完成时间对应的计费时段为准。高峰时段：北京时间周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00。空闲时段：除上述高峰时段外，其余均为空闲时段。
闲时时段以北京时间（UTC+8）为准；每日 18:00 - 次日 08:00 为闲时。闲时按闲时倍率（×0.3）、正常时段按正常倍率（×1.0）折算积分。
providerEvidence.eligibility: Enterprise subscription API key, available quota, participating DeepSeek V4 Flash/V4 Pro/V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3 only. Not every model in the plan; no assumption that merely-listed snapshots qualify.
providerEvidence.billingBasis: Subscription points, with model-specific coefficients; not a universal pay-as-you-go token price. Advertised minimum 1.2折 stacks annual subscription discount and is not the clock multiplier.

providerEvidence.quote: Peak hours are 01:00 to 04:00 and 06:00 to 10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday. All other hours are off-peak. Some public holidays are off-peak all day. A request costs the price at the time that Pareto accepts it.
providerEvidence.status: Normal weekly schedule only; holiday calendar unspecified and deliberately not borrowed from another provider. Visible warning and conditional status.
